REQ-HOST-001.text: 任何能力声明必须绑定新鲜、可复查的 Host Profile。

REQ-HOST-002.text: ChatGPT Work、Codex Desktop、Codex CLI 和不同 browser path 必须独立验证。

REQ-HOST-003.text: 未证明真实 Computer Use route 前，不得实现或宣传透明中间层。

REQ-HOST-004.text: 动作粒度、结果时序、覆盖率和绕过路径必须分别记录。

REQ-HOST-005.text: Hook trust、managed policy 或版本漂移导致失效时不得静默降级。

REQ-HOST-006.text: Oxrail Policy Core 可以适配其它 Agent/宿主的原生 Computer Use，但每个新宿主必须实现独立 Host Adapter、Host Profile、Capability Gate 与 NIF 证据；不得外推 OpenAI 路径结论。

REQ-ACT-001.text: V0.x 页面写执行权保留给 Native Computer Use。

REQ-ACT-002.text: 逐 click/type 宣传只允许在 `MICRO_ACTION` 路径通过后使用。

REQ-ACT-003.text: `deny` 必须由 side-effect probe 证明真实动作未发生。

REQ-RES-001.text: 公开 Hook feedback substitution 与 native typed rewrite 必须分开命名。

REQ-RES-002.text: 文本、结构化、图片、错误与附件结果必须分别验证保真度和持久化路径。

REQ-NIF-001.text: Native Computer Use 始终是普通运行阶段唯一 mouse/keyboard/page-write executor。

REQ-NIF-002.text: 普通非风险动作默认原样 pass-through；Oxrail 不模拟、重放、替代或二次执行原生输入。

REQ-NIF-003.text: 默认禁止改写 pointer coordinate、drag path、scroll delta、key sequence、click count、hover/focus semantics、viewport mapping。

REQ-NIF-004.text: 只有宿主正式 schema 提供 semantic target hint 字段且 Contract Test 通过时，Oxrail 才可补充语义提示；不得用提示层偷偷改最终坐标。

REQ-NIF-005.text: virtual pointer/cursor visualization、move、hover、click、double click、drag/drop、scroll、typing、shortcut、focus、dropdown、frame/screenshot feedback 必须保持原生语义。

REQ-NIF-006.text: 所有 result compression 必须保留经实测标记为 control-critical 的 metadata；任一相关字段为 `UNKNOWN` 时禁止替换该结果。

REQ-NIF-007.text: 普通运行阶段禁止注入会遮挡目标、改变布局/滚动或抢焦点的 overlay；调试标记必须 `pointer-events:none` 且默认关闭。

REQ-NIF-008.text: 控制权固定为 `RUNNING=Native`、`USER_LEASE_ACTIVE=Human`、`RESUMING=verify/invalidate/re-resolve`，之后才归还 Native。

REQ-NIF-009.text: Handoff 后必须废弃 handoff 前所有坐标型 target、element ref 和待执行 action，并递增 revision。

REQ-NIF-010.text: `NativeInteractionBench` 为 release-blocking；primitive semantic parity 必须 100%，意外 pointer/focus/scroll interference 与普通动作误拦截必须均为 0。

REQ-NIF-011.text: 任何原生交互回归都不能用 token、延迟或成功率收益抵消。

REQ-NIF-012.text: 若实现目标要求 Oxrail 自己 click/type/drag/scroll，则触发架构 Kill/Pivot，不得继续称 thin interposer。

REQ-OBS-001.text: 路由顺序固定为结构化集成/WebMCP优先、Native structured 次之、视觉最后。

REQ-OBS-002.text: Observer Bridge 必须由 Native Tuned gap 证明必要，并保持只读、可删除。

REQ-OBS-003.text: `additionalContext`、Bridge 输出与重试成本必须计入总观察成本。

REQ-OBS-004.text: 任何稳定 ref 必须绑定 revision，并在动作前重验。

REQ-HO-001.text: Handoff 只暂停 Agent 的浏览器动作与观察通道，不要求用户结束或重启对话。

REQ-HO-002.text: 首选呈现同一真实浏览器标签页；禁止复制登录页、伪造密码框或把 secret 代理到 Oxrail UI。

REQ-HO-003.text: 支持路径必须建立 `EXCLUSIVE_USER_LEASE`，Agent 在用户操作期间不能观察或控制浏览器。

REQ-HO-004.text: 优先把同一标签页移动到聚焦的临时 Chrome 窗口；不安全或不可用时聚焦原标签页。

REQ-HO-005.text: 完成后必须通过非敏感状态自动验证并自动恢复 Agent；不得要求用户回聊天发送“继续”。

REQ-HO-006.text: 无法可靠自动判断时只允许窗口内一键 `Done` 作为降级；稳定支持路径不得依赖聊天消息。

REQ-HO-007.text: 完成后尽可能把同一标签页恢复到原窗口、索引、固定和分组状态。

REQ-HO-008.text: Handoff 期间禁止读取字段值、键盘输入、剪贴板、截图、Cookie、Token 或密码管理器内容。

REQ-CRED-001.text: 首个稳定 Secure Credential Channel 仅支持拥有当前 Host Profile 与证据的 macOS 路径。

REQ-CRED-002.text: 凭据生成必须保留同一真实 Chrome tab/session/history/login state，并在任何 generate/reveal 动作前取得全 Agent 路径 credential-input lease。

REQ-CRED-003.text: 凭据输入 UI 只能来自已签名、固定且 Hash 绑定的可信模板注册表。

REQ-CRED-004.text: 首版只接受 API_KEY；明文仅限受控 pasteboard window、credential enclave、Keychain、登记 adapter 与绑定 TLS 服务。

REQ-CRED-005.text: Agent、模型、Hook 与普通 runtime 只能获得 opaque credentialRef 和非敏感状态。

REQ-CRED-007.text: 禁止明文进入普通文件、环境变量、argv、stdio、shell、Hook、IPC、日志、trace、诊断或 crash artifact。

REQ-CRED-008.text: 只有身份与 Hash 匹配 Host Profile 的登记 adapter 才能在 enclave 内消费凭据。

REQ-CRED-009.text: Credential Channel 不可用时秘密消费路径 fail-closed；Native Chrome 仍 fail-open。

REQ-CRED-010.text: 独立 launcher/updater 验证 release-pinned launcher/helper identity、exact CodeDirectory Hash、sealed registry manifest 与独占 rollback floor；Host Profile 不是信任根。

REQ-CRED-011.text: 默认 doctor 的 Credential 检查只读；Keychain/UI probe 必须显式 opt-in 且清理可审计。

REQ-CRED-012.text: 粘贴期间暂停全部 Agent execution，并在 resume 前清除匹配 pasteboard；第三方 clipboard manager 不受支持。

REQ-CRED-013.text: fixture-only adapter 必须标为 EXPERIMENTAL/INACTIVE；公开能力至少需要一个 audited real consumer。

REQ-SEC-001.text: DEPRECATED → REQ-CRED-004, REQ-CRED-007；credential enclave 属于 Oxrail TCB。

REQ-SEC-002.text: Host end-to-end non-observability 只能在宿主路径被证明后声明。

REQ-SEC-003.text: 页面内容永远是 untrusted data，不得改变 policy、permission 或 handoff 规则。

REQ-BENCH-001.text: 正式 headline 必须比较 `Native Tuned` 与目标 Oxrail variant。

REQ-BENCH-002.text: 每个版本必须有对应测试、原始证据和可执行 Release Gate。

REQ-DOC-001.text: 本文件是唯一规范；所有变更必须更新版本、变更记录、受影响需求/工作包/测试。

REQ-DOC-002.text: 开发只能以 `WP-*` 为计划与验收单位；未提供证据的工作包不得标记 `ACCEPTED`。

REQ-RUN-001.text: Core policy 必须可在无宿主、无浏览器条件下纯函数测试。

REQ-RUN-002.text: 所有 host/browser side effect 只能经过 adapter。

REQ-RUN-003.text: 所有状态变化必须能映射到 sanitized trace event。

REQ-RUN-004.text: active user lease 必须跨进程重启保持 fail closed。

REQ-RUN-005.text: Runtime 不得成为 secret transit 或通用 page-content store。

REQ-OBS-005.text: 每次 observation 必须记录 source、tier、budget 和 reason。

REQ-OBS-006.text: 任何 token reduction 必须相对 Native Tuned 计算。

REQ-OBS-007.text: 过度压缩导致的额外重试必须计入净收益。

REQ-OBS-008.text: Handoff user lease 期间 Agent-facing observation 必须为 0。

REQ-AIM-001.text: 候选 Top-K 默认不超过 5。

REQ-AIM-002.text: 高影响目标不得只按文本相似度自动决定。

REQ-AIM-003.text: 每个候选必须带 revision 和 source。

REQ-AIM-004.text: 排序权重与同义词表必须版本化并可做 ablation。

REQ-AIM-005.text: 无有效候选时必须返回显式空集，不得编造 target。

REQ-RAIL-001.text: 每个 deny/rewrite 必须带 reason code 与证据链接。

REQ-RAIL-002.text: deny side-effect = 0 必须由真实 fixture 验证。

REQ-RAIL-003.text: 所有规则必须按 granularity 限定声明。

REQ-RAIL-004.text: active user lease 下任何已知 browser action 必须被拒绝。

REQ-RAIL-005.text: Host schema 漂移时禁用 rewrite，而不是猜字段。

REQ-WHIP-001.text: `MICRO_ACTION` 路径第三次相同无进展动作不得发生。

REQ-WHIP-003.text: 动态无关变化不得重置 no-progress 计数。

REQ-WHIP-004.text: human boundary 不消耗 recovery retry。

REQ-WHIP-005.text: 所有结果按实际动作粒度报告。

REQ-REC-001.text: Recovery graph 必须无无限循环。

REQ-REC-003.text: R6 页面写动作只由 Native executor 执行。

REQ-REC-004.text: 预算耗尽必须进入 R7/R8，不继续自由猜测。

REQ-REC-005.text: Handoff 完成后恢复原 recovery context，而不是重建任务。

REQ-HO-009.text: Browser SMH secrets must be entered in the real page/browser UI; the fixed signed macOS API_KEY prompt is only a REQ-CRED-governed orthogonal exception.

REQ-HO-011.text: 同一 tab/session 绑定成功率 `>=99.5%`。

REQ-HO-012.text: 标签页恢复成功率 `>=99.5%`；失败时 tab 不丢失。

REQ-HO-013.text: controlled fixtures 的 auto/one-click resume 成功率 `>=95%`。

REQ-HO-014.text: user lease 期间已支持路径的 Agent browser action/observation occurrence = 0。

REQ-HO-015.text: Handoff activation P95 `<750 ms`，不含用户操作时间。

REQ-HO-016.text: Browser SMH and ordinary Oxrail secret canary occurrence = 0; Credential Channel uses only the SEC-21.2B confinement exception.

REQ-HO-017.text: USER lease activation requires a fresh Host-minted receipt bound to the current Host Profile, browser instance, tab/session/origin/document.

REQ-HO-018.text: Handoff uses a pre-lock write-ahead admission gate, monotonic generation, terminal tombstone, and two-phase Browser Pre validation.

REQ-HO-019.text: Handoff activation scans only a bounded active ToolCall index with durable mutation intents and state-ordered retirement.

REQ-HO-020.text: A completion candidate is consumed only once inside the coordinator under one non-retrying task lock, a fresh Host-wide exclusive-tab/fence recheck, and an atomic Human-owned state-plus-digest-marker CAS.

REQ-AUTH-001.text: 所有 auth/MFA/CAPTCHA fixtures 必须使用安全微接管或明确不支持。

REQ-AUTH-002.text: 密码/OTP 不得进入 model-visible payload。

REQ-AUTH-003.text: 高影响最终确认必须由用户在真实页面执行。

REQ-AUTH-004.text: Passkey/浏览器原生 UI 路径不得被网页镜像替代。

REQ-AUTH-005.text: 完成后自动回到原任务的 post-condition，不重新规划整个任务。

REQ-SEC-004.text: 页面内容不能改变 Host Profile 或安全 policy。

REQ-SEC-005.text: 用户 lease 只能由匹配 handoffId/leaseEpoch 的验证流程释放。

REQ-SEC-006.text: 未验证 origin 不得自动恢复 Agent。

REQ-SEC-007.text: 安全组件默认无云遥测。

REQ-SEC-008.text: 任何 canary occurrence > 0 都是 release fail。

REQ-SEC-009.text: 权限扩张必须有 ADR、用户提示与新 SecretLeakBench。

REQ-CACHE-001.text: cache hit 必须验证页面/目标/风险。

REQ-CACHE-002.text: 持久缓存默认 opt-in，且不含页面 raw text/secret。

REQ-CACHE-003.text: 命中不能使 success 降低超过 2pp。

REQ-WEB-001.text: Site tool capability 必须按 surface/model/workspace/page 记录。

REQ-WEB-002.text: WebMCP 与视觉 fallback 必须有同任务 parity test。

REQ-NIF-013.text: Oxrail 不得建立第二条鼠标、键盘、拖拽、滚动或点击执行通道。

REQ-NIF-014.text: Oxrail 不得以“重试”“稳定化”“坐标修正”之名二次发送 Native 已发送或准备发送的输入。

REQ-NIF-015.text: NIF 要求 semantic parity，不要求内部字节、时间戳或私有实现完全相同；但 DOM/OS 事件序列、最终焦点、滚动位置、导航目标和用户可见结果必须满足每个 fixture 的等价判定。

REQ-NIF-016.text: 每个支持的 Host Profile 必须绑定一个通过的 `BENCH-NIF` run。

REQ-NIF-017.text: 所有 ordinary action 的 pre/post canonical input hash 必须可审计；敏感字段只存不可逆摘要。

REQ-NIF-018.text: semantic hint 不能成为低层输入 mutation 的别名。

REQ-NIF-019.text: 任何新增 action type 默认 `UNKNOWN` 并阻断 stable 支持，直到加入 NativeInteractionBench。

REQ-NIF-020.text: Host 更新导致原语 schema、frame 或 viewport 语义变化时，旧 NIF 证据失效。

REQ-HOST-007.text: 安装或启用 Oxrail 禁止自动信任 Hooks、写入宿主 trust store 或默认使用任何 Hook trust bypass；用户必须在宿主 /hooks UI 中审阅并信任当前定义，Hash 变化后重新授权。

REQ-HOST-008.text: oxrail doctor / setup verification 必须逐项报告 plugin、Skill、Hook 注册与 trust、PreToolUse、PostToolUse、Chrome Computer Use、matcher/profile、Handoff 和最终 mode。

REQ-HOST-009.text: 安装验证不得强制下一次真实浏览器任务；有无害 synthetic probe 时优先使用，否则首次真实 Browser 调用只可被动记录 Hook 命中并原样透传。

REQ-HOST-010.text: 安装生命周期只使用 INSTALLED → CONFIGURED → VERIFIED；等待首个真实 Browser 调用时显示 READY — awaiting first native browser call。

REQ-HOST-011.text: Oxrail Hook 缺失、未信任、被禁用、超时或故障时必须让 Native Chrome Computer Use fail-open，并明确显示 Oxrail optimization unavailable / BYPASSED。

REQ-HOST-012.text: Safety/Handoff/Credential protection 只有在独立验证且当前实际生效时才可显示 ACTIVE；否则必须显示 INACTIVE 及原因。

REQ-HOST-013.text: Secure Credential Channel 必须按 OS、helper build/signature、template registry 与 consumer registry 独立验证；首版仅 macOS。

GATE-G0.title: Surface Contract
GATE-G0.summary: 分别记录： ```text chatgpt-chat chatgpt-work codex-desktop codex-cli ``` 以及： ```text chrome-extension built-in-browser other-browser-extension no-browser ```

GATE-G1.title: Tool Route Visibility
GATE-G1.summary: 真实 Computer Use 是否进入 `PreToolUse` / `PostToolUse`？

GATE-G2.title: Action Granularity
GATE-G2.summary: 每个 click/type/navigate 是否独立可见？

GATE-G3.title: Coverage & Bypass
GATE-G3.summary: 相关路径覆盖率是多少？是否存在 specialized/hosted/internal bypass？

GATE-G4.title: Input Rewrite Fidelity
GATE-G4.summary: `updatedInput` 是否符合真实 host schema，并改变真实动作而不破坏调用？

GATE-G5.title: Raw Result Visibility
GATE-G5.summary: `PostToolUse` 是否获得完整 text/image/structured/error result？

GATE-G6.title: Pre-model Replacement
GATE-G6.summary: 原结果是否在模型消费前被可靠替代？

GATE-G7.title: Result Fidelity
GATE-G7.summary: 替代后是否保持： - success/error； - image/screenshot； - structured fields； - citations/attachments； - Code Mode promise behavior； - downstream recoverability。

GATE-G8.title: Raw Persistence
GATE-G8.summary: 原结果是否已经进入： - transcript； - completion event； - temp file； - log； - crash artifact； - debug trace？

GATE-G9.title: Secure Micro-Handoff Control
GATE-G9.summary: 必须逐项证明： ```text conversation/task context remains alive → bind the exact same tab/session/document → grant EXCLUSIVE_USER_LEASE and deny Agent browser observation/action → detach same tab into a focused temporary Chrome window, or focus it in place → user acts only in the real website/browser UI → detect completion without reading values or keystrokes → settle + origin/state verify → restore original tab placement where possible → resolve an internal tool/event and automatically continue the Agent ``` 若只能提示用户“去浏览器处理完再回聊天说继续”，则 `GATE-G9` 失败。

GATE-G10.title: Deployment Survivability
GATE-G10.summary: Hook trust、managed-only policy、disabled hooks、插件更新、宿主更新会怎样？

GATE-G11.title: Native Tuned Increment
GATE-G11.summary: 在启用以下原生能力后，Oxrail 还有多少增益？ - WebMCP/Site tools（适用表面）； - `output_token_limit`； - native structured observation； - native read-only developer tools； - native approvals； - 原生恢复/历史能力。

GATE-G12.title: Native Interaction Fidelity
GATE-G12.summary: 必须在 `Native` 与 `Native + Oxrail(pass-through)` 间逐项验证 virtual pointer/cursor visualization、move、hover、click、double click、vertical/horizontal scroll、drag slider、drag & drop、typing、keyboard shortcut、focus switching、viewport coordinate mapping、dropdown/combobox、iframe、canvas-like target、rerender、new tab、modal、screenshot/frame feedback 与 human takeover → resume。 通过条件：primitive semantic parity `100%`、unexpected pointer/focus/scroll interference `0`、normal non-risk primitive incorrect block `0`。

GATE-G13.title: Control-Critical Result Contract
GATE-G13.summary: 通过字段消融、A/B next-action 和回放实验，识别下一步原生控制循环依赖的 metadata，形成按 `surface + build + route + media` 绑定的矩阵。任何待删除字段为 `UNKNOWN`、任何 screenshot/frame/viewport correlation 无法证明可丢弃、或任何下游控制回归出现时，该结果路径禁止压缩并降级到 `GUARD_ONLY` / `OBSERVE_ONLY`。

GATE-G14.title: Control Ownership & Resume Invalidation
GATE-G14.summary: 必须证明： ```text RUNNING: pointerOwner = NATIVE USER_LEASE_ACTIVE: pointerOwner = HUMAN; Agent action/observation denied RESUMING: verify → invalidate coordinate/ref/action cache → revision++ → re-resolve RUNNING: pointerOwner = NATIVE ``` 若 Handoff 后仍可能执行旧坐标、旧 element ref、旧 screenshot binding 或旧 pending action，则 structured micro-handoff 不成立。

GATE-G15.title: Credential Isolation & Scoped Consumption
GATE-G15.summary: 固定签名 macOS native template 将 API_KEY 限定在 credential enclave、Keychain、登记 adapter 与绑定 TLS service；模型/Agent 仅见 opaque credentialRef，禁止 generic export。

KILL-K1.trigger: 首要 Host 的真实 Computer Use 不进入可控 Hook
KILL-K1.mandatory_decision: 杀死该 Host 的 transparent middleware 定位；仅 Advisory/Unsupported

KILL-K2.trigger: 只能看见外层脚本，无法拦截 micro-action
KILL-K2.mandatory_decision: 杀死逐 click Rail/Whip 声明；降级 Transaction Guard

KILL-K3.trigger: 受支持路径存在任一已知相关动作绕过 Hook
KILL-K3.mandatory_decision: 不得称安全 enforcement；移除表面或能力

KILL-K4.trigger: public Hook result substitution 无法保留关键 media/成功语义，且 success 下降 >2pp
KILL-K4.mandatory_decision: 杀死该 FULL_INTERPOSE 路径；回到 Guard/Observe-only

KILL-K5.trigger: 任一 secret canary 出现在 Oxrail-owned model/context/trace/temp/crash/extension surface
KILL-K5.mandatory_decision: Release fail；停止分发并修复/轮换测试环境

KILL-K6.trigger: Handoff 中无法证明 Agent action 与 observation 已锁定

KILL-K7.trigger: 无法做到 same-task automatic/one-click verified resume
KILL-K7.mandatory_decision: 不得称 structured micro-handoff；标 Focus-only/Stop-and-notify

KILL-K8.trigger: Native Tuned 与 Oxrail 差距 <10%，且没有可靠性/摩擦优势
KILL-K8.mandatory_decision: 杀死 Bridge 或相应性能 headline，不必杀死 Guard

KILL-K9.trigger: Stall/Handoff false positive >5%，或 success 低于 Native Tuned >2pp
KILL-K9.mandatory_decision: 不发布对应功能，回到前一模式

KILL-K10.trigger: P95 Hook overhead >100ms 或端到端延迟增加 >5% 且无相称收益

KILL-K11.mandatory_decision: 不发 stable；缩小支持矩阵或 experimental

KILL-K12.trigger: 达到可靠性必须由 Oxrail/Bridge 执行 click/type/navigate/drag/scroll
KILL-K12.mandatory_decision: 停止 thin-interposer 路线或明确转型新项目；不得暗中漂移

KILL-K13.trigger: managed policy、trust 或 Hook disable 令 Oxrail 被跳过
KILL-K13.mandatory_decision: 该 Oxrail Profile/能力显示 BYPASSED/INACTIVE；Native Computer Use 继续；不得静默 Advisory 仍宣称 Guard

KILL-K14.trigger: ChatGPT Work 无法证明 Codex-style lifecycle Hook
KILL-K14.mandatory_decision: ChatGPT Work 仅使用其独立证明的能力；不得复用 Codex 结论

KILL-K15.trigger: 任一 Native primitive semantic parity <100%
KILL-K15.mandatory_decision: Release fail；禁用导致回归的 Oxrail 路径

KILL-K16.mandatory_decision: Release fail；删除干扰 UI/Hook/extension 行为

KILL-K17.trigger: 任一普通非风险 primitive 被 Oxrail 错误 block
KILL-K17.mandatory_decision: Release fail；修正 Guard，不能用成功率抵消

KILL-K18.trigger: 某功能需要改写最终 coordinate/path/delta/key/click/focus 才工作
KILL-K18.mandatory_decision: 杀死该实现；只允许 formal semantic hint 或 Native 执行

KILL-K19.trigger: control-critical metadata 为 UNKNOWN 或压缩后下一动作回归
KILL-K19.mandatory_decision: 禁用该 media/route 的 result compression

KILL-K20.mandatory_decision: 删除 overlay；不得以 UX 需要豁免

KILL-K21.trigger: Handoff resume 可能执行 handoff 前 coordinate/ref/pending action
KILL-K21.mandatory_decision: Release fail；强制失效和重新定位

KILL-K22.trigger: Handoff 所谓“安全窗口”是 clone/screenshot/fake form 而非同一真实会话
KILL-K22.mandatory_decision: 杀死该 Handoff surface；禁止秘密输入

KILL-K23.trigger: completion detector 必须读取字段 value、keypress、clipboard 或 screenshot 才可靠
KILL-K23.mandatory_decision: 禁用自动检测；退到窗口内 Done + non-secret verify 或不支持

KILL-K24.trigger: Observer Bridge 无法证明与 Native 操作的是同一 tab/document，错误率 >0.5%

KILL-K25.trigger: Bridge 必须拥有页面写、debugger write 或通用输入权限
KILL-K25.mandatory_decision: 删除 Bridge 或转为独立 Browser Agent 项目

KILL-K26.trigger: Host update 使 Profile stale，而运行仍继续用旧 enforcement claim
KILL-K26.mandatory_decision: 立即禁用 affected mode，修复 Doctor/更新机制

KILL-K27.trigger: README 性能/安全数字无法从发布 evidence 重算

KILL-K28.trigger: Work Package 标 ACCEPTED 但缺少 hash、命令、环境或 reviewer
KILL-K28.mandatory_decision: 降回 IN_REVIEW；里程碑 Gate 不计入

KILL-K29.trigger: API key 可被模型、Agent、Hook、普通 runtime 或 generic export surface 读取
KILL-K29.mandatory_decision: Release fail；禁用 Credential Channel 并撤销/轮换 fixture credential

KILL-K30.trigger: Agent、网页或页面内容能够构造或篡改 credential prompt/scope
KILL-K30.mandatory_decision: 杀死该请求路径；只保留固定签名 registry

KILL-K31.trigger: 错误 scope、过期、撤销或旧 generation 的 credentialRef 仍可消费
KILL-K31.mandatory_decision: Release fail；撤销 grants/items，Credential Channel 保持 INACTIVE

KILL-K32.trigger: Agent 在 credential-input lease 前触发/观察 key、lease 中任一 Agent path 可运行，或 reveal surface 仍可见时恢复
KILL-K32.mandatory_decision: Release fail；禁用 Credential Channel；该 Host 不得声称安全输入

KILL-K33.trigger: 错误 signer、替换/rollback registry 被接受，或匹配 pasteboard 在 Agent resume 时仍存在
KILL-K33.mandatory_decision: Release fail；禁用 helper、撤销 grants/items，并保持 Credential Channel INACTIVE

WP-DOC-001.title: Canonical SPEC validator and stable index
WP-DOC-001.goal: Make this living SPEC mechanically checkable and cheap for Agents to navigate.
acceptance: TOC, anchors, requirement matrix and WP index are generated without errors.
A change missing version/changelog impact fails CI.
blockers: KILL-K28 if an ACCEPTED WP can bypass evidence validation.

WP-DOC-002.title: Requirement–work-package–test coverage matrix
WP-DOC-002.goal: Maintain bidirectional coverage between normative requirements, implementation work and tests.
acceptance: Every P0/P1 REQ maps to at least one WP and one TEST/GATE.
Every release WP cites all mandatory global gates.
Orphans fail CI unless explicitly DEFERRED with ADR.
blockers: A requirement without executable acceptance cannot be marked implemented.

WP-DOC-003.title: External evidence freshness ledger
WP-DOC-003.goal: Track official Host/Chrome/competitor evidence, retrieval date, version and invalidation triggers.
acceptance: Every Host-dependent claim cites a PUBLIC_CONTRACT/CORE_IMPLEMENTATION/PROBE_REQUIRED record.
Release candidate reports no unresolved stale P0 evidence.
Official source summaries stay distinguishable from local experiment evidence.
blockers: Host behavior is never inferred solely from competitor documentation.

WP-DOC-004.title: Living-spec change, archive and migration automation
WP-DOC-004.goal: Keep one canonical file while preserving audit history and machine-readable migrations.
acceptance: No parallel authoritative SPEC is created.
Deprecated IDs remain searchable and point to replacements.
Released SPEC checksum and tag are reproducible.
blockers: Never overwrite a released tag or reuse a stable ID.

WP-FND-001.title: Monorepo, package boundaries and canonical files
WP-FND-001.goal: Create the minimal repository skeleton without committing to unproven Host capabilities.
acceptance: Install, lint, typecheck and empty test suites pass.
Production packages do not depend on Playwright/CDP write APIs.
Handoff and Observer extensions are separate capability modules.
blockers: KILL-K12/KILL-K25 if repository architecture embeds a second writer.

WP-FND-002.title: Core schemas, reason codes and evidence manifest
WP-FND-002.goal: Define versioned, validated data contracts before Host-specific implementation.
acceptance: No schema contains raw secret fields.
Schema hashes appear in evidence manifests.
blockers: Breaking semantics require a major schema version and migration plan.

WP-FND-003.title: Controlled fixture and paired benchmark harness
WP-FND-003.goal: Provide deterministic local pages, environment reset and paired Native/Oxrail execution.
acceptance: Baseline and Oxrail variants start from equivalent state.
Harness is not imported by production runtime.
blockers: Do not use real third-party accounts or secrets in V0.0.

WP-HOST-001.title: Surface inventory and public-contract ledger
WP-HOST-001.goal: Enumerate each ChatGPT/Codex surface, browser path and documented capability without cross-surface inference.
acceptance: ChatGPT Work, Codex Desktop, Codex CLI and built-in/Chrome paths have separate rows.
Every capability is labeled PUBLIC_CONTRACT, CORE_IMPLEMENTATION, PROBE_REQUIRED, UNSUPPORTED or UNKNOWN.
No public-plugin claim is inferred from Codex core implementation.
blockers: KILL-K14 if Codex evidence is reused for ChatGPT without a probe.

WP-HOST-002.title: Hook recorder, trust and failure harness
WP-HOST-002.goal: Record real Hook lifecycle events and characterize trust, concurrency, timeout and invalid-output behavior.
acceptance: Install/update never mutates Hook trust and never uses a bypass.
Hook unavailable/failure preserves the original Native Computer Use call and reports BYPASSED/INACTIVE.
Concurrent hooks do not rely on ordering.
blockers: Trust disabled or managed-only must surface BYPASSED/INACTIVE without disabling Native Computer Use, per KILL-K13.

WP-HOST-003.title: Real Computer Use tool-route discovery
WP-HOST-003.goal: Determine whether actual Computer Use calls—not echo tools—are visible to Oxrail Hooks.
acceptance: At least 100 controlled real Computer Use invocations per claimed route are classified.
Matcher is evidence-generated, not a hard-coded private tool name.
Profile records expected vs observed coverage.
blockers: KILL-K1 if the primary route is opaque; do not continue transparent-middleware claims.

WP-HOST-004.title: Action granularity and bypass characterization
WP-HOST-004.goal: Classify each route as micro-action, transaction, script-wrapper or opaque and identify every known bypass.
acceptance: Click/type/navigation traces map one-to-one only when labeled MICRO_ACTION.
Outer multi-action calls are labeled TRANSACTION/SCRIPT.
Coverage and bypass confidence are quantified.
blockers: KILL-K2/KILL-K3 apply without waiver.

WP-HOST-005.title: PreTool deny and input-rewrite side-effect probes
WP-HOST-005.goal: Prove deny happens before side effects and constrain updatedInput to safe, formal fields.
acceptance: Denied controlled clicks/types produce no page or OS side effect.
Low-level coordinate/path/key rewrites remain disabled after fixture-only characterization.
Only formal hint fields enter the allowlist.
blockers: KILL-K17/KILL-K18 on any normal false block or low-level rewrite dependency.

WP-HOST-006.title: Result timing, media fidelity and control-critical probes
WP-HOST-006.goal: Characterize text/image/structured/error/attachment results, model timing, persistence and next-action dependencies.
acceptance: Every media type has PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN, never a global boolean.
Feedback substitution and native typed lifecycle are separate.
Compression remains disabled until contract PASS.
blockers: KILL-K4/KILL-K19 disable unsafe result transformation.

WP-HOST-007.title: Code Mode, specialized routes and managed-policy matrix
WP-HOST-007.goal: Test nested promise semantics, specialized bypasses, disabled hooks and managed-only deployment.
acceptance: Every specialized path is supported, excluded or unknown.
blockers: KILL-K3/KILL-K13 for unhandled bypass or silent policy failure.

WP-HOST-008.title: Host Profile, Doctor and explicit user acceptance
WP-HOST-008.goal: Generate an evidence-backed profile, present capabilities/limitations and require informed acceptance.
deliverables: setup lifecycle state and passive first-call evidence
HostProfile v5 external schema pins and Credential Channel fields
acceptance: Profile key includes all required versions/routes.
Tool registry/input schema pins come from external Host probe/evidence, never self-validation.
Default doctor checks the complete setup matrix without issuing a real Browser action.
Doctor uses a harmless synthetic probe when supported; otherwise waits for passive first-call verification.
Passive first call records the route while preserving native input/result and side effects exactly once.
Lifecycle reports only INSTALLED, CONFIGURED or VERIFIED, including the required READY message.
Mode, NIF, result contract, handoff and forbidden claims are shown.
Stale/drifted/untrusted profiles disable affected Oxrail capabilities but keep Native Computer Use available.
Safety/Handoff inactive state and reasons are always visible.
Credential protection is separately ACTIVE/INACTIVE with probe reasons.
User acceptance is not requested every task unless capability changes.
blockers: KILL-K26 if stale enforcement continues.

WP-NIF-001.title: Native primitive fixture suite
WP-NIF-001.goal: Implement controlled fixtures for every required Native mouse/keyboard/focus/scroll/frame primitive.
acceptance: Fixtures cover rerender/new-tab/modal and handoff resume.
No production Oxrail executor code is introduced.
blockers: A missing primitive keeps Host NIF status UNKNOWN.

WP-NIF-002.title: Ordinary-action pass-through fingerprinting
WP-NIF-002.goal: Prove Oxrail does not mutate or replay normal Native input envelopes.
acceptance: All normal primitives have matching canonical low-level fields.
Semantic hint fields are isolated from primitive fields.
blockers: KILL-K15/KILL-K17/KILL-K18 on any unauthorized mutation or false block.

WP-NIF-003.title: Control-critical metadata experiment and contract
WP-NIF-003.goal: Identify result fields required by the next Native control loop using one-field ablation.
acceptance: Every field is REQUIRED/CONDITIONAL/OPTIMIZABLE/UNKNOWN with evidence.
Contract binds to Host Profile and media type.
blockers: KILL-K19 if a transformation proceeds with UNKNOWN or causes next-action drift.

WP-NIF-004.title: Zero-interference UI/overlay and ownership policy
WP-NIF-004.goal: Enforce no runtime overlay interference and encode Native/Human pointer ownership states.
acceptance: Release default injects no page overlay.
Debug marker is off, pointer-events:none, aria-hidden and layout-neutral.
RUNNING owner is Native; Oxrail is never owner.
blockers: KILL-K16/KILL-K20 on any pointer/focus/scroll/layout interference.

WP-SEC-000.title: V0.0 minimum safety and canary harness
WP-SEC-000.goal: Prevent early probes from normalizing secret leakage or unsafe real-account testing.
acceptance: No real credentials/MFA/payment data are used.
Auth boundary terminates the lane before observation.
Raw Hook spill/temp paths are included.
blockers: Any canary occurrence triggers KILL-K5.

WP-RLS-000.title: V0.0 feasibility decision and architecture disposition
WP-RLS-000.goal: Issue the first evidence-backed Go/Guard/Advisory/No-Go decision before product feature work.
acceptance: Any KILL is actioned, not deferred verbally.
blockers: If primary Host is opaque, V0.1 is narrowed to Advisory/other proven route.

WP-GRD-001.title: Browser tool classifier and versioned schema registry
WP-GRD-001.goal: Classify only evidenced browser tools/routes and validate every input before policy decisions.
acceptance: No private tool name is hard-coded without profile evidence.
blockers: No enforcement on a route absent from the valid Host Profile.

WP-GRD-002.title: ActionDigest, state fingerprint and progress baseline
WP-GRD-002.goal: Represent sanitized action identity and task-relevant state changes without storing input values.
acceptance: Dynamic noise does not automatically count as progress.
blockers: Do not infer micro-action progress on transaction-only routes.

WP-GRD-003.title: Repeated no-progress guard
WP-GRD-003.goal: Block only a proven repeated no-progress action/transaction before another side effect.
acceptance: Intervention occurs within the advertised two attempts.
blockers: KILL-K17 if any ordinary primitive is incorrectly blocked.

WP-GRD-004.title: Stale-target and risk guard
WP-GRD-004.goal: Require revalidation when document/revision/fingerprint changed and continuing could be unsafe.
acceptance: Low-risk harmless changes do not cause needless denial.
Risky stale actions are blocked before side effects.
Old ref use is visible in trace.
blockers: KILL-K18 if correctness depends on coordinate rewriting.

WP-GRD-005.title: Product-level ASK routing and high-impact policy
WP-GRD-005.goal: Map “ask” to existing Host approval or future Handoff, never to unsupported Hook output.
acceptance: High-impact approvals are never auto-allowed by Oxrail.
Normal actions are not routed to approval.
blockers: KILL-K13 if Host policy bypasses required approval.

WP-GRD-006.title: Guard trace, latency and conflict handling
WP-GRD-006.goal: Make Guard decisions observable, bounded and deterministic under concurrent Hooks.
acceptance: Safety denials fail closed; optional optimization may fail open.
blockers: KILL-K10 if overhead exceeds threshold without value.

WP-NIF-005.title: NativeInteractionBench CI and regression ownership
WP-NIF-005.goal: Run BENCH-NIF as an immutable release gate for all browser-facing changes.
acceptance: New primitives remain UNKNOWN until fixtures exist.
Every supported Host Profile links the run.
blockers: KILL-K15/KILL-K16/KILL-K17 are automatically enforced.

WP-RLS-010.title: V0.1 Guard Alpha release gate
WP-RLS-010.goal: Accept only the Guard granularity and claims actually proven on controlled fixtures.
acceptance: No token headline unless independently proven.
Marketplace install, manual Hook trust, new-thread Skill loading and default doctor flow are reproducible.
No install path trusts/bypasses Hooks or creates a real Browser test action.
Passive first-call and Hook-failure paths preserve Native Computer Use.
BYPASSED and Safety/Handoff INACTIVE states are unmistakable.
blockers: Failure returns to V0.0/affected WP; no partial public release.

WP-OBS-001.title: Native Tuned baseline configuration and report
WP-OBS-001.goal: Establish the strongest fair Host-native baseline before crediting Oxrail.
acceptance: Every safe native optimization is enabled/documented.
Unsafe truncation is identified rather than forced.
blockers: If Native Tuned closes the gap, apply KILL-K8 to unnecessary components.

WP-OBS-002.title: Observation source router
WP-OBS-002.goal: Choose structured integration/Site tool/native scoped/read-only companion/visual in fixed priority with explicit reasons.
acceptance: No task is forced into visual control when a suitable trusted structured tool exists.
Source chosen per step is traced.
Risk/scope checks precede Site tool use.
blockers: Do not use Observer Bridge unless WP-OBS-008 approves it.

WP-OBS-003.title: Normalizer, trust labels and secret redaction
WP-OBS-003.goal: Normalize Host/page observations into least-privilege state while preserving source/trust and critical metadata.
acceptance: Page content never gains policy authority.
Unknown fields are preserved or block transformation.
blockers: KILL-K5/KILL-K19 on leak or control metadata loss.

WP-OBS-004.title: Observation tiers and budget controller
WP-OBS-004.goal: Implement O0–O5 escalation with explicit token/latency accounting.
acceptance: No broad observation before lower tiers fail unless visual task requires it.
Budget overflow never truncates control-critical fields.
blockers: Token budget cannot override NIF or safety.

WP-OBS-005.title: Semantic candidates and formal target hints
WP-OBS-005.goal: Return small ranked candidates and, only where formal Host fields exist, attach semantic hints without mutating primitives.
acceptance: Hint does not alter coordinate/path/key fields.
blockers: KILL-K18 if hint is implemented as low-level rewrite.

WP-OBS-006.title: Revision, delta and stable-state contract
WP-OBS-006.goal: Track document/revision and return only safe deltas without treating old refs as stable coordinates.
acceptance: Noise does not automatically invalidate all state.
Every ref binds to source revision.
blockers: Stale coordinate execution triggers KILL-K21 when handoff-related.

WP-OBS-007.title: Safe result-transform adapter
WP-OBS-007.goal: Enable only evidence-backed media/route transformations before model consumption.
acceptance: No transform activates unless contract PASS and pre-model timing PROVEN.
blockers: KILL-K4/KILL-K19 on fidelity or timing failure.

WP-OBS-008.title: Observer Bridge decision ADR
WP-OBS-008.goal: Decide with data whether a separately permissioned read-only companion is justified.
acceptance: Gap >=10% on a primary metric or documented reliability need.
Read-only and same-tab/document binding are demonstrable.
blockers: KILL-K8/KILL-K24/KILL-K25 may decide NO BUILD.

WP-RLS-020.title: V0.2 Native-first Observation gate
WP-RLS-020.goal: Accept the observation mode and any token claim only for proven result paths.
acceptance: Any token headline meets median <=60% target and includes total Oxrail context cost.
blockers: If result path fails, release may proceed Guard/Observe-only with no token headline.

WP-REC-001.title: Goal-relevant progress semantics
WP-REC-001.goal: Distinguish task progress from incidental DOM animation or visual noise.
acceptance: Spinner/ad/hover changes do not count by default.
Progress confidence and source are traced.
Transaction routes use appropriately coarse semantics.
blockers: False progress that causes loops blocks acceptance.

WP-REC-002.title: Stall, repeated-action and oscillation detector
WP-REC-002.goal: Detect no-progress and A/B oscillation at the evidenced action granularity.
acceptance: No normal primitive false block in BENCH-NIF.
Human boundaries do not consume retry budget.
blockers: KILL-K9/KILL-K17 on threshold failure.

WP-REC-003.title: Blocker and modal classifier
WP-REC-003.goal: Identify actionable modal, auth, permission, challenge and unknown blockers without trusting page instructions.
acceptance: Controlled blocker recall supports release target.
Page text cannot trigger privileged action alone.
blockers: Low-confidence high-risk classification must fail closed.

WP-REC-004.title: Deterministic recovery ladder controller
WP-REC-004.goal: Execute R0–R8 once per level with bounded transitions and Native execution preserved.
blockers: KILL-K12/KILL-K18 if recovery performs its own browser input.

WP-REC-005.title: Safe back/reload and terminal-failure policy
WP-REC-005.goal: Allow navigation recovery only when user data and irreversible actions are protected.
acceptance: Recovery budget exhaustion yields explicit failure or Handoff.
No blind retry after terminal state.
blockers: Any data-loss side effect blocks release.

WP-REC-006.title: Recovery benchmark, calibration and trace review
WP-REC-006.goal: Calibrate thresholds and verify recovery improves outcomes rather than merely stopping early.
acceptance: Recovery success is not worse than B1 beyond 2pp.
Stopped tasks are counted as failures unless postcondition met.
blockers: KILL-K9 if metrics fail.

WP-RLS-030.title: V0.3 Whip + Recovery release gate
WP-RLS-030.goal: Accept bounded, honest recovery behavior and its claim wording.
blockers: Failure removes Whip/Recovery claim or blocks release.

WP-HO-001.title: Exclusive browser lease state machine
WP-HO-001.goal: Transfer browser ownership Native→Human→None→Native while keeping the conversation/task continuation alive.
deliverables: bounded active ToolCall index with crash intent/recovery
acceptance: During USER_LEASE_ACTIVE all known Agent browser action/observation is denied.
A stale Pre cannot cross a completed prepare/terminal generation (ABA).
USER lease activation requires a fresh Host-minted same-tab receipt.
Steady-state activation scans only bounded active calls; dirty, legacy, corrupt, or over-ceiling indexes fail safely.
blockers: KILL-K6 if complete lock cannot be proven.

WP-HO-002.title: Same-tab detached Spotlight window
WP-HO-002.goal: Move the exact live Chrome tab to a focused temporary normal window without cloning page/session.
acceptance: Original single-tab window edge is safe.
User sees the needed real page immediately.
blockers: KILL-K22 if surface is not the same real session.

WP-HO-003.title: Focus-existing-tab fallback
WP-HO-003.goal: Provide a safe fallback when tab movement is unsupported or would damage window state.
acceptance: No new login page is opened.
Failure terminates sensitive lane rather than cloning.
blockers: No automatic fake page fallback.

WP-HO-004.title: Pending handoff tool/event continuation and UI
WP-HO-004.goal: Keep the original Agent operation pending and resolve it when Handoff verification completes.
acceptance: No user chat “continue” on supported path.
blockers: KILL-K7 if same-task continuation is unavailable.

WP-HO-005.title: Narrow non-secret completion detector
WP-HO-005.goal: Detect completion using challenge disappearance, safe route/phase markers and origin—not secret values or input capture.
acceptance: No field value, keypress, clipboard, screenshot, cookie or token read.
False-complete is 0 on controlled high-risk fixtures.
Ambiguous state stays in lease or uses Done+verify.
blockers: KILL-K23 if reliable detection requires secret-like capture.

WP-HO-006.title: Automatic resume and one-click verified fallback
WP-HO-006.goal: Resolve the pending continuation automatically; use a Spotlight-local Done button only when auto-detection is inconclusive.
blockers: KILL-K7 for unsupported continuation; label capability honestly.

WP-HO-007.title: Post-handoff target/action invalidation and re-resolve
WP-HO-007.goal: Guarantee no pre-handoff coordinate/ref/pending action survives resume.
acceptance: All old coordinate/ref/action/frame bindings are rejected.
Revision and target cache epoch increment.
Minimal safe state precedes Native ownership restoration.
blockers: KILL-K21 on any stale execution path.

WP-HO-008.title: Origin, SSO, tab restoration and edge cases
WP-HO-008.goal: Safely handle redirects, system UI, tab topology and restore original placement where possible.
acceptance: Original placement is restored or failure recorded.
blockers: KILL-K5/KILL-K6 on leak or lease escape.

WP-HO-009.title: Full HandoffBench and friction study
WP-HO-009.goal: Prove the micro-handoff is faster and safer than stop-and-notify without hiding Host limitations.
acceptance: No browser reopen or chat continue on stable path.
Lease violations and stale execution are zero.
blockers: KILL-K6/KILL-K7/KILL-K21/KILL-K22/KILL-K23 enforce disposition.

WP-RLS-040.title: V0.4 Secure Micro-Handoff gate
WP-RLS-040.goal: Accept only Host Profiles with complete lease, real-page presentation and verified continuation.
blockers: No real-secret public beta yet; V0.5 required.

WP-SEC-001.title: Secret type system and redaction pipeline
WP-SEC-001.goal: Centralize secret classification, allowlists and redaction for every Oxrail-owned data flow.
acceptance: No secret-derived reversible hash is stored.
blockers: KILL-K5 on any occurrence.

WP-SEC-002.title: All-route action/observation lock enforcement
WP-SEC-002.goal: Prove USER_LEASE_ACTIVE blocks every known direct, nested, transaction and specialized browser route.
acceptance: Unknown route fails closed for sensitive tasks.
blockers: KILL-K6 if coverage is incomplete.

WP-SEC-003.title: Origin and redirect binding hardening
WP-SEC-003.goal: Prevent phishing, tab replacement and unauthorized cross-origin resume.
acceptance: SSO allowlist cannot be sourced from page content.
blockers: KILL-K5/KILL-K6 on unsafe resume.

WP-SEC-004.title: Prompt-injection and malicious-page defense corpus
WP-SEC-004.goal: Ensure page content cannot alter policy, request secrets, forge Handoff state or broaden permissions.
acceptance: Page instructions never modify Host Profile/permissions/lease.
No secret prompt reaches user via Oxrail.
blockers: Any policy takeover blocks public beta.

WP-SEC-005.title: Temp, transcript, crash and diagnostics scanning
WP-SEC-005.goal: Cover non-obvious persistence surfaces including Hook spill files and diagnostics.
acceptance: All documented scan surfaces are covered.
Diagnostics bundle contains no raw page/tool payload by default.
blockers: KILL-K5 immediately.

WP-SEC-006.title: Extension permissions, trust and managed deployment review
WP-SEC-006.goal: Minimize and explain plugin/extension permissions and handle enterprise policy honestly.
acceptance: Handoff and Observer permissions are separate.
blockers: KILL-K13/KILL-K25 on silent bypass or write permission drift.

WP-SEC-007.title: Race, fuzz and fault-injection hardening
WP-SEC-007.goal: Test tab/window/Hook/runtime crashes, late messages, replay and concurrent user/Agent actions.
acceptance: Crash defaults to no Agent action on sensitive lane.
blockers: P0 race failure blocks beta.

WP-SEC-008.title: Threat model, SECURITY.md and disclosure process
WP-SEC-008.goal: Publish the real trust boundaries, supported guarantees and reporting process.
acceptance: Guarantees distinguish Oxrail-owned from Host E2E.
Every permission and data flow is documented.
No unsupported “secrets never reach model” claim.
blockers: Documentation mismatch blocks public beta.

WP-RLS-050.title: V0.5 public-beta security gate
WP-RLS-050.goal: Authorize public beta only after full safety, NIF and evidence review.
acceptance: All beta claims map to evidence.
blockers: Any P0 failure blocks beta; no “known issue” waiver.

WP-CACHE-001.title: Session-local target and observation cache
WP-CACHE-001.goal: Reuse sanitized state within a task without crossing revision/document boundaries.
acceptance: Coordinates are not persistent cache keys.
blockers: KILL-K21 if old coordinate/ref survives.

WP-CACHE-002.title: Workflow recipe schema and recorder
WP-CACHE-002.goal: Represent reusable semantic recipes and verification rules—not low-level input replays.
acceptance: No absolute coordinates, key streams or secrets.
Risk/approval state is not cached away.
blockers: KILL-K12/KILL-K18 if recipe becomes input replay.

WP-CACHE-003.title: Recipe validation, invalidation and self-healing boundary
WP-CACHE-003.goal: Validate current page/target/risk before applying a cached semantic recipe.
acceptance: Cache hit always re-resolves target on current revision.
Validation failure is a miss, not a blind action.
blockers: Any blind cached action blocks acceptance.

WP-CACHE-004.title: Opt-in persistent cache privacy and controls
WP-CACHE-004.goal: Provide explicit, inspectable and revocable persistent recipe storage only if useful.
blockers: Skip implementation if benchmark benefit is insufficient.

WP-CACHE-005.title: Workflow-cache benchmark and go/no-go
WP-CACHE-005.goal: Measure first vs repeated runs and decide whether persistent caching deserves release.
acceptance: Benefit is material on repeated workflows.
False hit and stale action are zero on controlled set.
blockers: No material benefit → do not ship persistent cache.

WP-CRED-001.title: macOS Keychain Credential Channel vertical slice
WP-CRED-001.goal: Prove one narrow macOS API-key path through the exact real tab, a fixed native secure prompt and Keychain to scoped registered consumers without Agent-visible plaintext.
deliverables: signed macOS native credential helper with one fixed API_KEY template
one registered in-enclave HTTPS fixture adapter
at least one independently audited real-service consumer
release-pinned independent launcher/helper requirements, sealed registry manifest and launcher-owned rollback floor
credential-input lease and pasteboard hygiene path
HostProfile v5 and doctor capability evidence
acceptance: Exact authenticated Chrome tab/session is retained.
Credential-input lease starts before generate/reveal and blocks every Agent path until safe resume.
The one-time key reveal surface is absent before Agent resume.
Agent/page cannot define secure UI or scope.
Scope, TTL, generation and revocation are enforced.
macOS launcher/helper signer, sealed registry and rollback validation reject drift.
Matching pasteboard content is cleared before Agent resume.
Default doctor is read-only and extended Keychain probe cleanup is audited.
Fixture-only remains experimental; an audited real consumer passes its live probe.
Credential protection is ACTIVE only after GATE-G15.
blockers: KILL-K29 through KILL-K33 on leak, untrusted UI, lease escape, signer/rollback failure or scope escape.
Password/OTP popup, Private key, Windows, arbitrary CLI, generic env/file injection and third-party clipboard managers are out of scope.

WP-RLS-060.title: V0.6 Workflow Cache and macOS Credential Channel gate
WP-RLS-060.goal: Release only semantic, validated caching and a scoped macOS Credential Channel that preserve Native execution and privacy.
deliverables: credential capability table and sanitized G15 evidence
acceptance: Credential Channel is macOS/API_KEY-only and passes GATE-G15.
Public Credential capability includes an audited real-service consumer; fixture-only remains EXPERIMENTAL/INACTIVE.
Stale credential prerequisites display INACTIVE without affecting Native Chrome.
blockers: Can release V0.6 without persistent cache if no-go ADR says so; no Credential claim without WP-CRED-001 acceptance.

WP-WEB-001.title: Site-tool/WebMCP discovery by surface and page
WP-WEB-001.goal: Detect Site tool availability, scope and version without assuming all surfaces/models support it.
acceptance: Availability is bound to current surface/page/profile.
Discovery data cannot be spoofed by page text.
blockers: No browser-path claim based solely on built-in-browser WebMCP docs.

WP-WEB-002.title: Structured-vs-browser route arbitration
WP-WEB-002.goal: Choose Site tool when suitable, otherwise Native Computer Use, with deterministic scope/risk rules.
blockers: High-risk route requires WP-WEB-003 policy.

WP-WEB-003.title: Site-tool approval, scope and high-impact policy
WP-WEB-003.goal: Apply the same risk/confirmation boundary to structured tools as browser actions.
acceptance: High-impact tool calls preserve Host approval.
blockers: Unsafe tool scope blocks route.

WP-WEB-004.title: Cross-route state, cache and recovery consistency
WP-WEB-004.goal: Keep revision/progress/cache coherent when tasks switch between Site tools and Native browser.
acceptance: Browser state is re-observed when structured tool may change page.
Old refs invalidate after route change.
blockers: Stale browser action after Site tool blocks acceptance.

WP-WEB-005.title: WebMCP production parity benchmark
WP-WEB-005.goal: Compare structured and visual/semantic paths on equivalent tasks and document where each wins.
blockers: No global “WebMCP replaces browser” claim.

WP-RLS-070.title: V0.7 WebMCP production-routing gate
WP-RLS-070.goal: Accept deterministic, safe structured-tool preference with robust Native fallback.
blockers: Unsupported surfaces remain on their prior mode.

WP-COMP-001.title: Supported Host/browser/OS compatibility matrix
WP-COMP-001.goal: Define exactly which surface/build/browser/OS/mode combinations are stable, experimental or unsupported.
acceptance: Each stable row links current HostReality/NIF/Secret/Handoff evidence.
Built-in and real Chrome paths remain separate.
blockers: Rows without current evidence cannot be stable.

WP-COMP-002.title: Profile staleness, reprobe and drift response
WP-COMP-002.goal: Automatically invalidate and selectively reprobe after Host/plugin/browser/hook changes.
acceptance: User is prompted only when material capability changes.
blockers: KILL-K26 on silent stale-profile use.

WP-COMP-003.title: Managed-policy and enterprise deployment path
WP-COMP-003.goal: Support or explicitly reject enterprise environments where only managed hooks/extensions are allowed.
acceptance: Skipped plugin hooks never appear active.
blockers: KILL-K13 for silent fallback.

WP-COMP-004.title: Install, update, uninstall and rollback
WP-COMP-004.goal: Make lifecycle changes safe, reversible and compatible with Host trust/profile behavior.
acceptance: Uninstall removes Hooks/extensions/state without harming Chrome tabs/data.
blockers: No update may silently add browser permissions.

WP-COMP-005.title: Privacy-safe diagnostics bundle
WP-COMP-005.goal: Let users/support diagnose version/mode failures without exporting page or secret content.
acceptance: Bundle contains versions, schemas, reason codes and counts only by default.
Raw trace remains opt-in and sanitized.
blockers: KILL-K5 on leakage.

WP-COMP-006.title: Secondary surface/browser feasibility
WP-COMP-006.goal: Evaluate one secondary surface or browser path using the full gate stack, without diluting primary stability.
acceptance: Unsupported result is acceptable and documented.
blockers: Do not delay V1.0 primary path for an unproven secondary surface.

WP-RLS-080.title: V0.8 compatibility and lifecycle gate
WP-RLS-080.goal: Accept a maintainable support matrix and safe install/update/rollback lifecycle.
acceptance: Every stable row has NIF evidence.
blockers: Shrink support matrix rather than weaken gates.

WP-RC-001.title: Full release-candidate benchmark campaign
WP-RC-001.goal: Run all current baselines, variants and release suites on frozen candidate artifacts.
acceptance: Minimum run counts and fairness rules pass.
blockers: Any global gate failure blocks RC.

WP-RC-002.title: Performance and footprint hardening
WP-RC-002.goal: Reduce cold-start, Hook latency, memory and package size without weakening safety or NIF.
blockers: KILL-K10 if overhead remains unjustified.

WP-RC-003.title: Packaging, signing and distribution preparation
WP-RC-003.goal: Create reproducible, least-privilege release artifacts for supported distribution channels.
acceptance: No test harness/write Driver is bundled.
blockers: Unexpected permission/dependency blocks signing.

WP-RC-004.title: Onboarding, Doctor and user-facing docs validation
WP-RC-004.goal: Validate install→Doctor→capability acceptance→normal use for new users.
acceptance: No repeated acceptance on every task.
Permissions and Handoff behavior are understandable.
blockers: Confusing safety/permission UX is release-blocking if it can cause unsafe use.

WP-RC-005.title: State/config migration and rollback rehearsal
WP-RC-005.goal: Prove upgrades and emergency rollback do not retain unsafe stale state or lose control of Handoff tabs.
acceptance: Old profiles become stale or migrate safely.
Active handoff update is blocked or safely canceled.
Rollback does not reuse incompatible targets/contracts.
blockers: Any stale target/control ownership leak blocks RC.

WP-RC-006.title: Independent security and architecture review
WP-RC-006.goal: Obtain an independent review focused on Host reality, NIF, Handoff, permissions and evidence integrity.
acceptance: All P0/P1 findings closed or feature/surface removed.
No scope drift into second executor.
blockers: Open P0/P1 blocks V1.0.

WP-RC-007.title: Soak, crash recovery and stability campaign
WP-RC-007.goal: Run long sessions, repeated tasks and failure injection to find state/lease/profile leaks.
blockers: Any ownership/secret regression blocks RC.

WP-RLS-090.title: V0.9 release-candidate gate
WP-RLS-090.goal: Freeze the V1.0 candidate only when artifacts, evidence, docs and operations are complete.
blockers: Failure returns candidate to development; tag is not reused.

WP-V1-001.title: Stable support-matrix freeze
WP-V1-001.goal: Freeze the exact Host/browser/mode combinations included in V1.0.
acceptance: Every stable row has current HostReality, NIF, Secret and applicable Handoff evidence.
blockers: Remove a row rather than weaken gates.

WP-V1-002.title: Kill Criteria disposition and architecture conformance
WP-V1-002.goal: Prove every KILL condition was checked and the final architecture remains a thin native-preserving layer.
blockers: Any unresolved P0 Kill blocks V1.0.

WP-V1-003.title: Evidence reproduction and release claim lock
WP-V1-003.goal: Reproduce every V1 performance, safety and compatibility claim from signed evidence.
acceptance: Every number/claim has exact profile, run IDs and method.
Independent rerun matches within declared tolerance.
blockers: KILL-K27 if any claim cannot be reproduced.

WP-V1-004.title: Final documentation, limitations and release notes
WP-V1-004.goal: Publish concise, truthful docs that let users understand capability modes, NIF and Handoff behavior.
acceptance: Handoff does not promise an embedded page where only focus is supported.
NIF and result-control limitations are visible.
blockers: Documentation mismatch blocks publication.

WP-V1-005.title: Stable publish and rollback readiness
WP-V1-005.goal: Publish signed V1.0 artifacts with tested rollback and incident controls.
acceptance: Artifacts match accepted RC hash or documented rebuild.
Rollback artifact is available and tested.
blockers: Any artifact mismatch blocks release.

WP-V1-006.title: Post-release drift and incident monitoring
WP-V1-006.goal: Detect Host changes and safety regressions after release without collecting page content.
acceptance: Host changes mark profiles stale promptly.
Affected capability can be remotely/documentedly disabled without page telemetry, according to policy.
Incident criteria and owners are defined.
blockers: KILL-K26 if stale capability continues silently.

WP-RLS-100.title: V1.0 final acceptance
WP-RLS-100.goal: Make the final Go/No-Go decision for the first stable release.
acceptance: All global and mode-specific gates pass.
All final scenarios for supported modes pass.
No active P0/P1 finding or KILL.
Canonical SPEC and evidence are immutable at tag.
blockers: No partial override: remove failing surface/capability or do not release.
